limitations: The durable inbox is isolated synthetic evidence persistence and recovery. It has no observation-to-ledger credit command, balances, listing approval, payment verification, seller release, custody or broadcast authority.

Retained browser evidence covers the standalone synthetic English desktop/Arabic mobile rehearsal, not an integrated deposit product route, actual native mobile app or chain-connected wallet.
